one_line: Name the product in the first words, then let top-down hands show the box, the make and the result.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 top-down handheld view of two red-and-yellow Giotto be-bè boxes on a wooden table, then a close-up of the Green Car box. Voiceover (transcript) and word-by-word subtitles: "ערכות יצירה" (0:00), "לפעוטות" (0:01), "דבר כזה קודם!!" (0:04).
q1_hook.why: The first words name the product and its audience, said and subtitled together (H1, H6, H2), and a bright, branded box fills the frame at 0:00 (S1, H3). "איך לא היה דבר כזה קודם" (transcript) promises a payoff. No person speaks to camera (H4).

beats.what: Top-down boxes on a table; "ערכות יצירה לפעוטות ... דבר כזה קודם!!"
beats.why: Category, audience and a promise at once

beats.what: Hands fold a number game, show markers and dough; as an OT she praises crafts (transcript)
Hands soften pink dough and press it on a number-2 card; "אבל לפעמים ... איפה הטושים"
beats.why: The tired-parent problem, said while the hands work

beats.what: Green Car box, felt-tip and chalk boxes; "כבר נעשתה בשבילי"
beats.why: The answer: the thinking is done for you

beats.what: A woman and a toddler at a low table colour a cardboard car
Top-down hands colour the car, add black wheels; a road with flower stickers
beats.why: The make in 9 s of quick cuts

beats.what: Road signs, traffic lights, felt tips, folded bushes; "במחיר שווה במיוחד"
beats.why: More pieces in the kit and a price claim

beats.what: The finished car rolls down a ramp road; "מיומנויות התפתחותיות"
Outdoors, a chalk box opened; "זה מוצר אחד שסוגר לכם פעילות שלמה"
beats.why: A second kit from the range

beats.what: A chalk road with the car on it; "תכתבו לי", "קישור לערכות", "תהנו!!"
beats.why: The ask over a final play scene

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: At 0:54: "תכתבו לי" with a link promise, but no keyword. Caption: "רוצה קישור לאתר? תכתבי לי בהודעה". No question to answer, nothing to send or save.
q2_flow.why: A problem, a turn at 0:20 and a result at 0:45 form a clear arc with a new hands-on picture every 1 to 3 s (K2, R3). Several kits and a payoff at 0:45, followed by 14 more seconds of other products and the ask, spread the story (R1, R4).

q3_cta.what: 0:54-0:57, voiced and subtitled: "תכתבו לי" / "קישור לערכות" / "גם כאן המלאי מוגבל" / "תהנו!!". Caption: "תיכנסו לאתר של @superkitcraft" and "רוצה קישור לאתר? תכתבי לי בהודעה".
q3_cta.why: Said and shown at the very end, after the value, and repeated in the caption (C6). But "write to me" has no keyword (C3), the caption adds a second path, visit the site (C1), and the subtitles sit around 70% down, in the bottom 35% (C6).

q4_shown.what: Branded boxes 0:00 and 0:20; a paper number game 0:04; markers and dough 0:07-0:19; a woman and toddler colouring 0:23-0:26; hands colouring and fitting wheels 0:27-0:36; road signs 0:37; the car on a ramp 0:45; a chalk road 0:52-0:59. No price number.
q4_shown.why: The boxes are handled from 0:02 (S1), and hands-only demos carry the Reel (S4). The OT credential is only said, with no face or badge (S6). "במחיר שווה במיוחד" gives no price (S3), and no disclosure words appear (S7).

q5_edit.what: 33 shots in 59.5 s, about 1.8 s each; hard cuts, about 20 between 0:25 and 0:52. Word-by-word subtitles synced to the voiceover, key words larger. Motion blur as the car rolls. Voice until 0:57. Ends on the car on a chalk road.
q5_edit.why: A cut every 1 to 3 s with a new picture keeps the pace high (E2, R3). Word-by-word subtitles follow the voice, so a muted viewer can follow (E4). At 59 s with five kits, the length is long for the message (R2).

q6_topic.what: An occupational therapist recommends Giotto creative kits that save a parent from hunting for pens and glue. Serves parents who want a ready craft activity.
q6_topic.why: "אבל כאימא, לפעמים אין לי כוח להתחיל לחפש" (transcript) is a tired-parent concern that makes parents feel understood (K6). The expert line and the make are practical information wrapped in a personal story (K4).

q7_filmed.what: Mostly top-down handheld shots of hands on a wooden table and a carpet in bright daylight; one high-angle medium shot of a woman and a toddler at a low table; an outdoor top-down on paving. Brand labels readable.
q7_filmed.why: Top-down hands put the viewer in the maker's seat (F5), with boxes and pieces filling the frame and legible (F4). Sharp, evenly lit and home-made (F7, H8). Subtitles sit low over the hands (F2).

q8_text.on_screen: Word-by-word subtitles, bold white with a dark edge, centred about 70% down, one to three words at a time, key words larger: "ערכות יצירה" (0:00), "דבר כזה קודם!!" (0:04), "במחיר שווה במיוחד" (0:39), "מיומנויות התפתחותיות" (0:48), "תכתבו לי" (0:54), "קישור לערכות" (0:55), "גם כאן המלאי מוגבל" (0:56), "תהנו!!" (0:57).
q8_text.caption: "ערכות היצירה של Giotto be-be’ לפעוטות וילדים!". About 85 words: benefits, a developmental claim, a pointer to @superkitcraft, "רוצה קישור לאתר? תכתבי לי בהודעה", the tag @giotto_israel. No hashtags, no disclosure words.
q8_text.why: Every spoken line is subtitled in short chunks held about 1 s, so it works muted (T1, T5), but the chunks are near a full transcript (T2) and sit in the bottom 35% (T4). The caption's first line names the product and kinds of kits in search words (T7); only tags disclose (T8).

weak_points: Five kits in 59 s dilute the message; "במחיר שווה במיוחד" with no price; the "limited stock" urgency is unsupported; the OT credential is only said; disclosure by tag only; the ask has no keyword and a second path.
lumebook_takeaway: Film top-down hands on a table: the box, the contents laid out, the make, one finished result; word-by-word subtitles and one DM keyword in the last 4 s.
not_verified: Whether the hands and the woman at 0:23-0:26 are the creator, and whose voice it is. The toddler's age. The price. Whether the post was paid beyond the tag and coauthor listing. Music is not evident. Correction to src/coded: the woman's face shows only in profile at 0:23-0:26 and from behind outdoors. Lead edit 18 Oct: resolution remarks removed, because the downloaded copy can be smaller than what was posted.
